# Location

## Summary
A named physical place — somewhere things happen, ship to, or are held at.
Shared-realm block at `location.gts`.

## API
- `name` — StringField (drives `cardTitle`)
- `kind` — StringField label in the consumer's vocabulary (Stadium, Office, Warehouse); deliberately free text and never a lifecycle, so it is not colour-coded
- `address` — base `AddressField`
- `geo` — catalog `GeoPointField` (`{ lat, lon }`); isolated renders it as a map when set
- `phone` — base `PhoneNumberField`; `website` — base `WebsiteField`
- `description` — MarkdownField

## Usage
```ts
import { Location } from '../location';

@field venue = linksTo(Location);
```
Embedded is a pin row (name, city/country, kind pill); fitted adds place,
kind and street progressively across the size tiers; isolated is the place's
page with map, address, reach and about panels.

## Non-goals
Everything a place means to one domain stays on the consumer: a stadium's
capacity (see the Capacity field), a warehouse's racking, an office's desks.
That split is what lets one Location serve an event's venue and an order's
pickup point without either seeing the other's baggage. Rooms/areas within a
place are a consumer concern until a real second consumer demands a shared
sub-location shape.
